mentions.name: GenAI Marketing Tools Directory
mentions.description: This is a curated directory of generative AI tools for marketing, organized by which part of the marketing job each tool is relevant for. Inspired by the Lumascape, the list is manually curated with automations used to collect the relevant fields; it was vibe coded with Replit (also hosted there), using Strawberry + Comet for scraping and structured output and Brandfetch for logos.
mentions.problem: It's hard to keep track of which GenAI tools launch almost every week and which are relevant for which part of the marketing job.
mentions.audience: Marketers looking for generative AI tools relevant to their part of the job.
mentions.source_excerpt: the last few weeks I've been working on a directory for GenAI tools for marketing.
